summary: Unified #648 checkpoint/approval primitive: durable .agentic/checkpoints ledger, create/decide/list/get surfaces (MCP + gh plate checkpoint), policy auto-approve for low impact at medium+ risk, AutonomyEngine run_cycle pauses on open checkpoints, PLATE-CHECKPOINT markers.
migration_impact: New MCP tools plate_checkpoint_* and CLI gh plate checkpoint. Open pending medium+ checkpoints pause unsupervised autonomy cycles. Ledger files appear under .agentic/checkpoints/ (gitignored recommended for local-only, or commit when used as audit). No breaking config schema changes.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate_core / surfaces to pick up checkpoint module.
2. Optionally add .agentic/checkpoints/ to .gitignore if local-only; commit selected records when they are the audit trail.
3. Agents: call plate_checkpoint_create before high-impact actions; humans decide via plate_checkpoint_decide or gh plate checkpoint --decide ID --decision approve.
4. Autonomy loops: plate_autonomy_status open_human_checkpoints now includes open pausing checkpoints.
agent_notes: Prefer plate_checkpoint_create over ad-hoc comments for human gates. Pair with #645 shadow_id when a ShadowReport requires approval. TUI ask_user_question host bridge and Projects fields are follow-ups.
